payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the specific black DVD from the source image into a white DVD while preserving its identity and continuity as that same object.
outcome.target: The original DVD-like object near the center of the source image remains identifiable as the same DVD and is white.
outcome.reference: The small rectangular DVD-like object near the center of the source image, not other objects or newly introduced discs.

check.question: Is the specific DVD from the source image still identifiable as that same object and transformed to white?
check.complete_when: The original small rectangular DVD-like object near the center remains identifiable as the same DVD and is visibly white; a different, duplicated, or newly introduced white disc does not satisfy this criterion.
check.partial_when: The same original DVD remains identifiable and shows a visible change toward white, but is not yet fully white.
check.absent_when: The original DVD remains unchanged, or it has disappeared, been replaced, or cannot be identified as the same object; white discs elsewhere or duplicates alone do not count as progress on the requested transformation.
check.unknown_when: Available evidence is insufficient to determine whether the original DVD remains identifiable as the same object or whether its color changed toward white.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The original small rectangular DVD-like object near the center is no longer visible in the edited image. The white discs shown elsewhere do not preserve its identity, so the requested transformation has not progressed."}

parsed.evidence: The original small rectangular DVD-like object near the center is no longer visible in the edited image. The white discs shown elsewhere do not preserve its identity, so the requested transformation has not progressed.
